description: This file defines the SecureSocketPort class and its nested classes and interfaces, which provide an abstraction for secure socket communication, including certificate handling, validation, and socket state management within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Represents a secure socket port with methods for opening, closing, and data transmission, managing socket state, and handling SSL/TLS certificates.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
classes.description: Encapsulates an X.509 certificate and its associated SSL context, providing methods to retrieve issuer, subject, validity period, hostname validation, and verification.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::IValidator
classes.description: Interface for validating certificates, allowing custom validation logic.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Internal class managing socket connection states, data transfer, and SSL handshake process, derived from Core::SocketPort.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently open.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently closed.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the socket is suspended.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::HasError
methods.description: Checks if the socket has encountered an error.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Open
methods.description: Opens the socket connection with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Callback
methods.description: Sets a callback validator for certificate validation.
